newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike estimates raised.

text.p: - Goldman Sachs raised its earnings estimates for Nike Inc based on the company's announced 66 percent increase in worldwide futures orders, analyst Margaret Mager said.
- For the current fiscal year ending May 31, 1997, the brokerage raised its estimate to $5.30 a share from $5, compared with $3.77 in fisal 1996.
- For fiscal 1998 the brokerage raised its estimate to $6.30 a share, Majer said.
- Goldman rates the stock a buy on its U.S. recommended list.
